messages:
Incident Bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service= inference-runtime, incident=INC-4091, urgency=high. Trigger: increased 5xx rate across eu-west. https://pagerduty.example/INC-4091 :rotating_light:
PagerDuty: Primary on-call Alex paged (phone/sms). Escalation policy: 10m -> secondary -> manager.
Alex: acked INC-4091 via pager (oncall app) — looking.
Alex: quick note — seeing spike on asg-gpu-01, tailing logs now.
Maria: @Alex any customer-facing impact yet?
Alex: no SLO breaches yet but error rate climbing to ~4.2% from 0.2%. latency steady. possible KV cache eviction loop.
Devon: adding context — we deployed model-router v2 rollouts ~22:10 UTC, small config tweak to batching. Could be related.
Incident Bot: 10m elapsed with no resolution, auto-escalating to secondary (Maria).
PagerDuty: Secondary on-call Maria paged.
Maria: Acked INC-4091. jumping in. any hypothesis?
Alex: hypothesis: router config + burst traffic causing KV cache churn, evicting prefixes -> regen + increased 5xx. I can roll router to previous config.
Jamie (mgr): On call manager paged (manager escalation). If primary/secondary can't resolve in next 15m escalate to manager.
PagerDuty: Manager page to Jamie sent. Jamie: No response (mobile DND). PagerDuty: Attempting call -> no answer -> escalation will continue.
Maria: I pushed a quick canary rollback to model-router -> rolling back to v1 config across eu-west. command: ``kubectl -n inference set image deployment/model-router model-router=redwood/model-router:v1.12.3``
Devon: Added temp autoscale bump for gpu pool: ``asg set-capacity asg-gpu-01 --min=4 --max=8``. hoping to absorb burst.
Alex: logs show 503s correlating with k8s liveness probe failures on router replicas. rollback in progress.
Incident Bot: Manager escalation triggered due to missed ack; paging manager alternate (Sam) per policy.
PagerDuty: Sam paged.
Sam: Acked INC-4091. I'm coming in. Any blockers?
Maria: rollback completed, router replicas healthy, 5xx dropping to 0.8% and trending down.
Alex: Confirming client errors stopped after cache warmup. latency normal.
Devon: keeping autoscale bump for 20m to be safe, will revert after stable.
Jamie (mgr): (later) I missed the page was in DND, catching up — appreciate the manual rollback. any customer incidents?
Maria: no active customer pages. one customer (acme-corp) saw degraded responses for ~6m, we opened a DM and offered post-incident summary.
Sam: will follow up with oncall rotation to review alert thresholds; looks like the rollout flag should have gone to canary longer.
Alex: creating incident doc and assigning postmortem. provisional owners: Alex (triage), Maria (mitigation writeup), Devon (root cause).
Maria: Handing off to next on-call (Sam) for 20:30-23:30 UTC window — leaving runbook notes in the incident doc. :white_check_mark:
Sam: Received handoff. I'll watch for regressions, will also patch the rollout pipeline to include KV-cache smoke test.
Incident Bot: Incident INC-4091 acknowledged by Sam, status=monitoring.
PagerDuty: Incident resolved? set to monitoring.
Alex: closing thread here, will add timeline + logs to the incident doc. thanks all. :raised_hands:
